description: This file defines the interface TypedDataManagerInterface for managing typed data objects in Drupal, including methods for creating data instances, definitions, validation, and canonical representations.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a typed data object instance based on data type and configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new typed data object based on a data definition, value, name, and parent.

methods.name: createDataDefinition
methods.description: Creates a data definition object for a specified data type.

methods.name: createListDataDefinition
methods.description: Creates a list data definition for items of a given data type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a property instance for a typed data object based on options.

methods.name: getPropertyInstance
methods.description: Gets a typed data instance for a property of a given typed data object.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Retrieves the validator for validating typed data.

methods.name: setValidator
methods.description: Sets the validator for validating typed data.

methods.name: getDefaultConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves default validation constraints for a data definition.

methods.name: getCanonicalRepresentation
methods.description: Returns the canonical representation of a TypedData object.
